Diego sat alone in his apartment and thought about his future. He had lost everything he built, but he still had his dream and his determination. Then his phone buzzed with a message, and Diego looked at the screen with hope. The message would change everything, but he did not know it yet, and the next part of his journey was about to begin.

**NEXT EPISODE TEASE:**
What will the message say? Will Diego start over? Find out in Part 2: "Starting Over in a New Language."
